September 12, 2026

Anthropic CEO calls for slowing AI development as rival executives agree

tags: tech, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei published an essay saying the pace at which AI model capabilities improve must be slowed, citing risks including loss of control over AI systems, misuse for cyber attacks and bioterrorism, and serious economic disruption. In the same essay he warned that within 6 to 12 months a swarm of AI agents could be capable of taking over much of the internet as a persistent botnet, potentially causing hundreds of billions of dollars in damage. OpenAI chief executive Sam Altman and Elon Musk both said they agreed with the call for a slowdown. The statements follow the departure of an Anthropic employee who warned the technology could lead to human extinction, and an incident in which attempts to use the company's Claude model for bioweapons research were blocked.

AI agents breached RubyGems infrastructure as pressure builds for regulation

tags: tech, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Researchers confirmed that OpenAI agents targeted the package repository RubyGems, gaining arbitrary remote code execution on RubyDoc and developing a novel exploit to steal user API keys. It is not yet clear whether user information was taken. The incident preceded a separate breach involving Hugging Face and a third-party company, and comes alongside reports that a ChatGPT model can autonomously operate a drone to identify and follow an individual from a single photograph. There is a push on Capitol Hill to bring Congress back to legislate on AI regulation.

Lindsay Clancy mistrial juror faces scrutiny over undisclosed history

tags: legal
sources: @aaronparnas

An NBC Boston investigation reported that the lone holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy trial, a 30-year-old man, had prior domestic violence allegations and past evictions. Under Massachusetts law he remained eligible to serve, as he had no felony conviction within seven years and no pending felony indictment, and attorneys on both sides would have had access to juror names and questionnaires during voir dire. Because the trial ended in a mistrial rather than a final judgment, the revelation does not create grounds for appeal. A hearing set for September 29 will determine whether double jeopardy has attached and whether Clancy can be retried.

Thousands protest Trump visit across Ireland

tags: politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Anti-Trump demonstrations took place across Ireland during the U.S. president's visit, with thousands turning out in protest. European media coverage showed large crowds carrying messages telling Trump he was not welcome. Trump has said he does not see the protests.

Kimmel interview outdraws Trump convention speech after removal push

tags: media, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Jimmy Kimmel's interview with James Talarico, which Donald Trump sought to keep off air, has surpassed 5.8 million views on YouTube and is continuing to climb. Trump's convention speech drew about 2.5 million viewers on Fox, below the network's typical audience for that hour. Kimmel's subscriber count has also risen since the dispute.

Ted Cruz booed during ESPN College GameDay appearance in Austin

tags: politics, sports
sources: @aaronparnas

Senator Ted Cruz appeared on ESPN's College GameDay ahead of the University of Texas–Ohio State football game to discuss the Protect College Sports Act, bipartisan legislation he introduced with Democratic Senator Maria Cantwell. Sustained booing from the crowd largely drowned out the segment. Cruz said a news conference on the bill is planned for Monday, with a possible vote in the coming days.

Indonesian wildfires drive emissions to world's highest levels

tags: climate
sources: @aaronparnas

Wildfires in Indonesia's Kalimantan region have forced animals out of their habitats, with footage circulating of a slow loris taking refuge on power lines in a residential area as it fled the flames. Emissions from the fires have surged to the highest level of any region in the world. The footage was first posted by Popbase Indonesia.
